test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four parts. Identify the part that contains a grammatical error.

Jack probably/ strained his back/ as the box was/ too heavier.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect comparative adjective "**heavier**" following the adverb "**too**."
 
• When using the word "too," the correct form should be "**too heavy**," not "too heavier."
 
• Comparative adjectives like** "heavier"** are used to compare two things, whereas **"too"** implies an excessive degree.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Jack probably strained his back as the box was **too heavy**."*
